rules.statement: Under Section 549(2) of the Administration of Justice (Amendment) Law, No. 25 of 1975, a decree holder can execute a decree against the legal representative personally if no property of the deceased is found in their hands or under their control and they fail to account for such property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Subsection (2) of s. 549 of the said Law, however, creates an exception to this general rule. It enables the decree holder in certain circumstances to execute the decree in the same manner as if the decree had been entered against the legal representative personally."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Subsection (2) of s. 549 of the Administration of Justice (Amendment) Law, No. 25 of 1975

meta.parties: Dias v. De Mel and Another
